content.short: CoinTracker is a premier crypto portfolio tracking and tax solution.
content.description: CoinTracker provides advanced cryptocurrency portfolio tracking and tax reporting tools to help users manage holdings, monitor performance, and meet regulatory obligations. The platform tracks more than $50 billion across various cryptocurrencies and exchanges, giving users a clear view of assets, gains, and losses to inform financial decisions. After a successful $100M Series A, CoinTracker is positioned to become a central, lasting contributor to the crypto ecosystem, guiding users toward sustainable growth.
